div.div: Traffic paths North-south: VM (172.20.1.x) -> VPC gateway (SNAT 10.80.0.0) -> Geneve -> Transit Gateway SR + Tier-0 SR on en02 -> uplink 3330/3331 -> lab router | East-west inside a VPC: host-to-host Geneve on VLAN 3328, never leaves the hosts | Private (172.20.x, private TGW) prefixes are never advertised
